title: HHHusher FAQ (v2)
description: A cream FAQ split in two: on the left a pinned index of question groups (big numbers on the left, names pushed right; the group you're reading at full strength, the others faded to 15%), on the right the questions between 2px faint rules, each with an outlined plus square that fills dark on hover and opens the answer.
notes: CSS only: native details for the answers, sticky index, and named scroll timelines that light the current group (timeline-scope); without support every group shows at full strength
the index sits above the list on phones
